# DV descriptive statistics (SM Table 8)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

dat$MP <- as.factor(dat$MP)

DV <- c("stress_VAS","MDBF_valence_mood","MDBF_calmness_mood", "MDBF_energy_mood",   "fatigue_VAS",
        "desire_soc_VAS", "loneliness_VAS" )

for (i in 1: length(DV)){
  
  t <- dat[, c("ID", "Condition", "MP", DV[i])]
  names(t) <- c("ID","Condition", "MP", "x")
  t <- t %>% 
    group_by(ID, Condition, MP) %>%
    summarise(x = mean(x)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Condition, MP) %>%
    summarise(M = mean(x), SD_b = sd(x), N = length(x)) %>%
    mutate (CI_down = M - qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N), CI_up = M + qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N)) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    mutate(M_ov = mean(M, na.rm=TRUE), SD_ov = mean(SD_b, na.rm=TRUE),  
           CI_down_ov = mean(CI_down, na.rm=TRUE), CI_up_ov = mean(CI_up, na.rm=TRUE))
  
  t$var <- DV[i]
  
  if (i==1){
    Mt <- t
  }else{
    Mt <- rbind(Mt,t)
  }
}

# Per condition and hour
Mt[c(1:7,12)]

# Per condition
unique(Mt[c(1,5,8:12)])
```


# Exploratory analyses with gender (SM Table 9)

## Prepare variables

```{r}
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Grouping and independent variables ---

# subject number of each participant
dat$ID <- as.factor(dat$ID)

# Condition - "Baseline" is a reference category compared to "Isolation"
# express the conditions numerically before participant mean centering (PMC)
dat$cond_num[dat$Condition=="Baseline"] <- 0
dat$cond_num[dat$Condition=="Isolation"] <- 1

# Gender - "F" (treated as the reference factor) and "M"
dat$gender <- as.factor(dat$gender)

# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# Participant mean centering (PMC) - level 1 variables

# Condition
dat <- scale_within(dat, variables="cond_num",  within="ID",prefix = "pmc_", center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

# Freetime
dat <- scale_within(dat, variables="freetime",  within="ID",prefix = "pmc_", center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)


```

## Run models

### 1. Loneliness


```{r}

mod.loneliness.g <- lmer(loneliness_VAS ~ pmc_cond_num +  gender +
                           ema_time + pmc_freetime +
                           ( pmc_cond_num +  ema_time  + pmc_freetime | ID), data = dat, 
                         REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

summary(mod.loneliness.g)


mod.loneliness.g <- lmer(loneliness_VAS ~ pmc_cond_num *  gender +
                           ema_time + pmc_freetime +
                           ( pmc_cond_num +  ema_time   | ID), data = dat, 
                         REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

summary(mod.loneliness.g)


```
